title: 第162章 店员
slug: 求生游戏请叫我诚信商人
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

护卫队将原料区再次仔仔细细里里外外都搜查了一遍。

没有找到任何破绽。

沉铁青着一张脸：“估计不在原料区了，再去其他地方找找。”

西莉亚的目光扫了一圈，不怎么在意地收了回去。

羽灵族大殿下：“随便吧，反正也与我羽灵族无关，只是那条人鱼能够从这么森严的看管之中逃出来，黑铁港重建后的安保让人存疑。”

她说完并不停留，转身就进入了电梯。

看到翎还停留在原地，呵斥道：“还不进来？”

翎垂眸走到她的身后。

电梯门合上时，李知与翎的目光有短暂对视。

她若无其事地移开，自然而然地扫过还在原料区的沉和西莉亚，又收回了视线。

有顾客已经表示不满：“这里是准备封锁吗？你们黑铁港还没重新开业，就开始限制客人行动了？”

原料商们保持沉默，目光搜寻着可疑的存在。

西莉亚和沉低语两句，决定让要离开的顾客再接受一遍检查，并且查问与顾客有接触的其他人，都没问题就可以离开。

查问很快就到了李知。

她的5级商人身份，注定不会接受太多查验。

再加上刚刚一起八卦的顾客和原料商们互相印证，没过多久她就被准许放离。

电梯里，李知透过透明的玻璃，看着壮阔的海面。

光影倒映出她模糊的面容。

只能看到一片平静。

电梯停在一层港口，李知随着其他几个顾客一起走出电梯，回到1号传送阵，将传送地点定位在了浓绿集市。

等她和这一批顾客离开之后。

西莉亚和沉拿到了她们的传送坐标。

“没问题，再看看下一批。”

李知从浓绿集市随手买了些日用品，就从自己的传送点，直接传送回了不忘危。

这里依旧流水潺潺，安静得如同室外桃源。

李知将所有的材料按照比例加入建造台，就在溪流边，找了块不那么湿的石头坐下了。

观看建造台从零到一建造一桩房屋是很治愈的。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The escort team carefully searched the raw material area inside and out again.

No flaws were found.

Shen Tie's face turned pale: "It's probably not in the raw material area anymore. Let's look for it elsewhere."

Celia's eyes glanced around and took them back without paying much attention.

His Highness the Yuling Tribe: "Whatever, it has nothing to do with my Yuling Tribe anyway. It's just that the mermaid was able to escape from such strict guarding. The security of the Black Iron Port after its reconstruction is questionable."

She didn't stop after saying that, turned around and entered the elevator.

Seeing Ling still staying where he was, he scolded: "Why don't you come in?"

Ling lowered his eyes and walked behind her.

When the elevator door closed, Li Zhi and Ling's eyes met briefly.

She moved away as if nothing had happened, naturally glanced at Shen and Celia who were still in the raw material area, and then withdrew her gaze.

Some customers have expressed dissatisfaction: "Is this place preparing for a blockade? Your Black Iron Port has not yet reopened, and you have begun to restrict the movement of guests?"

The raw material dealers remained silent, looking for suspicious presences.

Celia and Shen whispered a few words and decided to let the customer who was about to leave undergo another inspection and check other people who had contact with the customer. If there was no problem, they could leave.

The inquiry soon arrived at Li Zhi.

Her status as a level 5 merchant is destined not to receive too many checks.

In addition, the customers and raw material vendors who had just gossiped together confirmed each other, and it didn't take long for her to be allowed to leave.

In the elevator, Li Zhi looked at the magnificent sea through the transparent glass.

The light and shadow reflected her blurry face.

All that could be seen was peace.

The elevator stopped at the port on the first floor. Li Zhi walked out of the elevator with several other customers, returned to the No. 1 teleportation array, and positioned the teleportation location at the Dark Green Market.

After she and this group of customers leave.

Celia and Shen got their teleportation coordinates.

"No problem, let's look at the next batch."

Li Zhi bought some daily necessities from the Dark Green Market, and then teleported directly back to Wuwangwei from his teleportation point.

The water is still gurgling here, and it is as quiet as an outdoor paradise.

Li Zhi added all the materials to the construction platform in proportion, and found a stone that was not so wet to sit by the stream.

Watching the construction bench build a house from scratch is therapeutic.
